airport.name: Zadar Airport
airport.description: Zadar Airport sits in Zemunik Donji, about 30 km (36 min) by road from the villa. In summer 2026 it had 68 regular scheduled routes, 50 of them operated by Ryanair (Ryanair has a base here); in winter almost everything stops apart from domestic Croatia Airlines flights (Zagreb, Pula) and a twice-weekly Croatia Airlines link to Munich.
airport.notes: A new departures terminal was under construction for the 2026 season; a temporary tent structure ('Facility C') with five extra gates was in use in 2025.

transfers.description: About 30 km and 35-40 minutes by car from the ZAD terminal to the villa, via Zadar's ring road and the Nin road. You avoid the Old Town entirely, and the villa has its own driveway parking.
transfers.notes: OSRM free-flow routing (no traffic). Allow extra time on summer Saturdays, which are changeover day.

transfers.description: Fixed-price airport transfer to Privlaka/Sabunike: about €55 for a standard car or €70 for a passenger van, per vehicle and not per person. A 20% surcharge applies between midnight and 06:00.
transfers.notes: Price list from one operator (taxi-in-zadar.com), labelled valid 1 Jun–1 Oct 2025, so 2026/27 prices may differ. We are only quoting a published price, not endorsing the operator.

transfers.description: Online transfer marketplaces quote about €68–69 one way for a sedan (1–3 people) and about €100 for an 8-seat minivan.
transfers.notes: Snapshot prices from transfercroatia.com (€68 standard, €100 mini van) and mytransfers.com (€68.75 sedan, per a search snippet). Treat as indicative only.

transfers.description: Uber operates pickups at ZAD, and Bolt is also reported in Zadar. The official taxi rank is directly opposite the arrivals exit. Use the app's quote for Sabunike.
transfers.notes: We found no sourced Uber or Bolt fare to Privlaka. The airport–city centre fares we saw (€10–20) are not comparable, because Sabunike is further away in the opposite direction.

legs.leg: Airport shuttle ZAD → Gaženica ferry port → Zadar bus station → Old Town
legs.notes: Timed to the flight programme; the timetable is published monthly. Baggage is included and the ticket is valid 90 min for onward city buses.

legs.leg: Liburnija suburban line 101/102 Zadar bus station → Privlaka (a Sabunike stop is listed on some runs)
legs.notes: One-way fare for 'Privlaka' (stop 63) from the Liburnija suburban EUR price list; the document says one-way prices are valid from 22 Aug 2022 (file name says 01.01.2023).

transfers.description: The budget route costs about €8.20 per person: the €5 airport shuttle to Zadar bus station, then the Liburnija suburban bus to Privlaka/Sabunike for €3.19. It works well on weekdays, but at weekends only three buses a day run to Privlaka.
transfers.notes: The timetable above is the winter timetable valid from 01.11.2025; we did not find the summer 2026 timetable. It is not clear which Privlaka stop is nearest the villa. Shuttle fare from absolute-croatia.com/bookiscout (not the operator's own page). Verified 2026-10-16: the 01.11.2025 PDF is still the only Privlaka timetable linked on liburnija-zadar.hr.

transfers.description: Major rental brands have desks at or next to the ZAD terminal (Avis/Budget, Enterprise/National, Europcar/Goldcar, Hertz, Sixt, plus local firms). A car is worth having in Sabunike for trips to Nin, Pag, Zadar and Paklenica.
transfers.notes: Lists differ between aggregators. Some 'airport' firms are off-site in Zemunik Donji with a shuttle. National's location page confirms an in-terminal counter (07:00–23:00).

tolls.description: The A1 motorway (Zagreb–Split) is tolled by distance. A car (category I) pays €17.30 from Zagreb to Posedarje, or €17.60 to Zadar centar; the cheaper IA category applies to motorcycles.
tolls.notes: HAC price list, stated as applying from 1 Jan 2023 (still the published list). OSRM routes guests off the A1 at the 'Zadar zapad' exit (signed Nin, Smilčić), which the HAC Zagreb-entry table we read does not list separately, so the exact toll for that exit needs confirming. Croatian motorways not run by HAC (e.g. the Rijeka–Zagreb A6) have separate tolls.

tolls.description: Slovenian motorways need an e-vignette. It costs €16 for 7 days or €32 for 1 month for a car.
tolls.notes: Price (€16 for 7 days) re-checked on autovig.eu (verified 11 Oct 2026 against the official tariff); the €32 monthly price was not re-confirmed. Buy only at the official evinjeta.dars.si.

tolls.description: Austrian motorways need a vignette. In 2026 it costs €9.60 for 1 day or about €12.80 for 10 days. The Tauern and Karawanken tunnels have separate section tolls.
tolls.notes: Sources conflict on the 10-day price (€11.50 vs €12.80). Section tolls for the Tauern/Karawanken tunnels were not researched.

ferries.days: 26–28 Jun Fri/Sat/Sun; 3 Jul–30 Aug Mon/Wed/Fri/Sat/Sun; extension to 6 Sep Wed/Fri/Sat/Sun
ferries.description: In 2026 Jadrolinija ran a 4-hour fast catamaran between Ancona and Zadar's Gaženica port from late June to early September. It carries foot passengers only, no cars. From the port it is a 30-minute drive to the villa.
ferries.notes: Season and times are from absolute-croatia.com and croatiaweek.com, and the extension was confirmed 31 Aug 2026. Whether bicycles are carried is not confirmed. Whether the service returns in 2027 is unknown. Reported capacity of Jelena varies (300–403 passengers) between sources, so it is not stated. Older ferrycroatia.com articles describe an earlier, pre-COVID Zadar–Ancona service with the same vessel, so "new" applies to the 2026 relaunch only.

ferries.description: Guests bringing a car from Italy can take the overnight car ferry from Ancona to Split (about 9–11.5 h, run by Jadrolinija and SNAV), then drive about 2 h 15 min north on the A1 to Sabunike.
ferries.notes: We found no confirmed 2026 timetable; the frequency of up to 6 sailings a week is from aggregators. We found no conventional Ancona–Zadar car ferry for 2026.

alternativeAirports.name: Split Saint Jerome Airport
alternativeAirports.description: Split Saint Jerome Airport: 139 km, about 2 h 01 min by car to the villa. Split is a larger airport than Zadar and widens the choice of routes and dates (its network was not researched here). The drive is all motorway on the A1.
alternativeAirports.notes: Drive figures are OSRM free-flow car routing without traffic, border or ferry waits.

alternativeAirports.name: Rijeka Airport
alternativeAirports.description: Rijeka Airport: 236 km, about 3 h 35 min by car to the villa. Rijeka airport is on Krk island, and the drive crosses the Krk bridge. Its route network was not researched.
alternativeAirports.notes: Drive figures are OSRM free-flow car routing without traffic, border or ferry waits. OSRM routes this via the coastal D8 (Jadranska magistrala); a motorway route via A6/A1 may be faster.

alternativeAirports.name: Zagreb Franjo Tuđman International Airport
alternativeAirports.description: Zagreb Franjo Tuđman International Airport: 307 km, about 3 h 38 min by car to the villa. Zagreb is Croatia’s capital and main hub, and the best fallback in winter, when ZAD has almost no international flights. Guests can connect onward to ZAD on Croatia Airlines (up to 11 flights a week in summer 2026) or drive about 3.5 h on the A1.
alternativeAirports.notes: Drive figures are OSRM free-flow car routing without traffic, border or ferry waits.

alternativeAirports.name: Pula Airport
alternativeAirports.description: Pula Airport: 408 km, about 5 h 52 min by car to the villa. Pula is in Istria. Its drive time looks long, but it has a direct Croatia Airlines connection to ZAD.

publicTransport.description: FlixBus connects Zadar bus station with Zagreb, Ljubljana, Graz, Vienna, Munich, Prague and Budapest, plus the whole Croatian coast and Plitvice. From the bus station, the villa is 20 km (28 min) by car, or a Liburnija suburban bus to Privlaka.
publicTransport.notes: Connections are the 'popular trips' listed on flixbus.com and are not all confirmed as direct. Journey times not researched.

publicTransport.description: No passenger trains run to Zadar. Rail travellers ride HŽPP to Knin, then take a bus to Zadar (about 1 h 50 min). For most guests a direct coach from Zagreb is simpler.
publicTransport.notes: Sources are undated and conflict on whether HŽPP's combined rail+bus ticket via Knin still runs.

publicTransport.description: Liburnija suburban buses run between Zadar bus station and Privlaka about 14 times on weekdays, but only 3 times on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. The fare is €3.19. Nin, the nearest town, is 5 km and 9 minutes from the villa by car.
publicTransport.notes: The timetable is the winter timetable valid from 01.11.2025 (still the only Privlaka timetable linked on liburnija-zadar.hr on 2026-10-16); the summer timetable was not found. Fares are from the Liburnija suburban EUR price list (one-way prices stated valid from 22 Aug 2022).

flightStats.method: Parsed the official Zadar Airport S26 timetable JSON (the data behind zadar-airport.hr/en/timetable). Arrival records with a validity span < 7 days are excluded as one-off/charter rotations, matching the site's own isRegularFlight() rule. weeklyFrequency = peak number of arrivals into ZAD in any Mon–Sun week; weeklyFrequencyMidsummer = peak in 6 Jul–23 Aug; weeklyFrequencyShoulder = peak in mid-Apr–May and mid-Sep–mid-Oct weeks. months = calendar months with at least one scheduled arrival in S26 (29 Mar–24 Oct 2026). Verification note: the 7-day filter can drop real first/last rotations of a regular route (e.g. Austrian VIE from 30 Apr); VIE, ZAG, PUY and CTA dates were corrected to the actual first/last timetable rows.

winter2026_27.notes: ZAG and PUY: Croatia Airlines PSO routes (year-round, frequency unconfirmed). MUC: Croatia Airlines 2x weekly across winter 2026/27 per EX-YU Aviation 7 Oct 2026. Trade Air OSI winter status unconfirmed.

LGW includes Enter Air tour-operator charters (likely not seat-only); only easyJet (23 Jun–29 Aug, Tue/Sat) is a sure seat-only option.
OSRM drive times are free-flow; the Pula (5 h 52) and Rijeka airport (3 h 35, via coastal D8) times look slow versus motorway routing.
A1 exit used by routing is signed Nin/Smilčić/Zadar-zapad; HAC tariff names this toll station differently, so the exact toll (Posedarje €17.30 vs Zadar centar €17.60) remains unconfirmed.
HAC price list is labelled valid from 1 Jan 2023; no newer tariff found but a 2027 change is possible.

verification.method: All 68 route + 8 alternative-airport + ZAD coordinates compared to OurAirports (all within 1 m). All 68 routes re-derived from the airport S26 JSON (dates, months, airlines; also checked no regular-rule origin is missing). All 24 OSRM routes re-run (identical). Drive origins, bus station, Gaženica, Nin and villa street re-geocoded via OSM Photon (Nominatim was rate-limited, HTTP 429). All 39 non-OSRM source URLs fetched. Prices re-checked on taxi-in-zadar.com, transfercroatia.com, Liburnija PDFs, HAC price list, airport-shuttle page, autovig.eu.
